Method of Attack: Disguised as a legitimate Google Drive extension
Serves forged MFA requests to compromise email and cryptocurrency accounts
Replaces email confirmations on the fly to trick users into providing authorization codes
Utilizes forged dialogs to deceive users into revealing two-factor authentication
Impacted Systems: Chromium-based browsers (Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave Browser, Opera)
Indicators of Compromise: Part of Rilide’s source code leaked on an underground forum
Similar browser extensions advertised for sale
